title: Define order position fill budget and protective stop contracts
description:
Define the trading lifecycle and protection contracts as frozen, slotted standard-library dataclasses and Enums. Use Decimal for every quantity, price, fee, notional, and budget. Reject float, NaN, Infinity, and negatives where not meaningful, and require UTC-aware datetimes. Do not force share or tick rounding. This task runs at the same time as b.1, b.2, and b.4, so do not import mike_trade.domain.instruments, market, signals, strategy_types, or accounts at runtime. Use small private validators. Any cross-module annotation goes under `if TYPE_CHECKING:` with string annotations. Account and scenario identity is an opaque `account_scope_id: str`; a symbol is never an account.

mike_trade/domain/trading.py:
- Enums:
  - OrderSide: BUY, SELL.
  - PositionDirection: LONG active, SHORT dormant.
  - OrderType: MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, STOP_LIMIT, TRAILING_STOP.
  - TimeInForce: DAY, GTC.
  - OrderPurpose: ENTRY, STRATEGY_EXIT, PROTECTIVE_STOP, MANUAL_CLOSE, SAFETY_EXIT, EOD_CLOSE.
  - BrokerOrderStatus: NEW, PENDING_NEW, ACCEPTED, PARTIALLY_FILLED, FILLED, PENDING_CANCEL, CANCELED, EXPIRED, REJECTED, REPLACED, UNKNOWN, with a TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUSES frozenset.
  - ManagementStatus: MANAGED, UNMANAGED, ADOPTED.
  - PositionCycleState: PENDING_ENTRY, OPEN, EXITING, CLOSED, ABANDONED.
- `OrderIntent` holds: intent_id, client_order_id (idempotency key), account_scope_id, cycle_id, symbol, side, purpose, order_type, time_in_force, and exactly one of quantity or notional (>0). It also holds limit_price/stop_price (required by type), trail_price or trail_percent (exactly one for TRAILING_STOP), signal_id (optional), and created_at. Opening a short must fail: SELL with purpose ENTRY raises.
- `BrokerOrder` holds: broker_order_id, client_order_id, account_scope_id, symbol, side, order_type, status, quantity, filled_quantity (0 <= filled <= quantity), filled_avg_price (required when filled > 0), limit/stop/trail fields, submitted_at, updated_at, and replaced_by (optional). Add an `is_terminal` property.
- `Fill` holds: fill_id (broker execution ID, the idempotency key), broker_order_id, account_scope_id, symbol, side, quantity > 0, price > 0, fee >= 0, and filled_at (UTC).
- `PositionCycle` enforces one intentional long entry followed by one complete discretionary exit. It holds: cycle_id, account_scope_id, symbol, direction LONG, state, entry_strategy_key (optional), entry_fills (tuple), exit_fills (tuple), opened_at, and closed_at. Pure methods return new instances and raise on violations:
  - `apply_entry_fill`: allowed in PENDING_ENTRY/OPEN while no exit has started, so broker partial fills of the single entry are accepted; side must be BUY.
  - `begin_exit`: allowed only from OPEN with remaining > 0.
  - `apply_exit_fill`: side must be SELL; cumulative exit qty must not exceed entry filled qty; reaching zero remaining sets CLOSED.
  - Any entry fill after an exit has started, or after CLOSED, raises (no pyramiding or averaging down).
  - Add properties: entry_quantity, exit_quantity, remaining_quantity, avg_entry_price, avg_exit_price, realized_pnl (Decimal, fees included).
- `Position` is a broker-truth or ledger view. It holds: account_scope_id, symbol, quantity (>0 for long), avg_entry_price, market_value (optional), cost_basis, management (MANAGED/UNMANAGED/ADOPTED; positions observed externally default to UNMANAGED), cycle_id (optional, required when MANAGED), and as_of.
- `BudgetPolicy` holds: per_symbol_budget, total_application_budget (>= per_symbol), max_open_positions (int >= 1), planned_loss_per_trade (optional), daily_loss_limit (optional), and require_broker_buying_power (default True).
- `EntryEligibilityPolicy` holds: max_filled_entry_cycles_per_symbol_per_session (int >= 1), consecutive_loss_lockout_threshold (optional int), lockout_scope_by_strategy (bool), post_sale_cooldown (timedelta >= 0), min_hold_for_strategy_exit (timedelta >= 0, applying only to STRATEGY_EXIT and never to stops, manual closes, or safety exits), and entry_kill_switch (bool).
- `EntryEligibilityState` holds: account_scope_id, symbol, session_date, filled_entry_cycles, consecutive_losses, last_exit_at, locked_until (optional), and block_reasons. Add a method `entry_blocked(now) -> tuple[str, ...]`. Entry blocks never affect exit eligibility, and a helper `exit_allowed(purpose, held_for)` must return True for PROTECTIVE_STOP/MANUAL_CLOSE/SAFETY_EXIT/EOD_CLOSE regardless of min hold.

mike_trade/domain/protection.py:
- `ProtectionKind` enum: FIXED_STOP, BROKER_TRAILING_STOP, STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP.
- `ProtectionStatus` enum: PENDING, ACTIVE, REPLACING, UNKNOWN, CANCELED, TRIGGERED, UNSUPPORTED.
- `ProtectionPolicy` holds: kind, stop_offset_percent or stop_offset_amount for fixed stops, trail_percent or trail_amount for trailing kinds, step_size and activation_gain for stepped, and require_broker_held (default True), with kind-specific validation.
- `TrailingStopState` holds: cycle_id, account_scope_id, symbol, kind, status, covered_quantity (>0), stop_price, high_water_mark, broker_order_id (optional), and last_confirmed_at (optional UTC).
- Pure methods:
  - `ratchet(new_stop_price, observed_high)` never lowers stop_price for a long and raises on a downward move.
  - `with_covered_quantity(remaining)` resizes coverage to the actual remaining quantity and rejects coverage greater than remaining.
  - `start_protection(policy, cycle, fill_price)` is a classmethod or function that raises unless the cycle has positive filled entry quantity.
- Add `combined_sell_exposure(protective_qty, pending_exit_qty, position_qty) -> bool`, which reports whether overlapping sells could exceed the position and create a short.

tests/contracts/test_trading_contracts.py should hold positive and negative tests for all invariants above. Cover at least: partial entry fills accepted; second entry after exit start rejected; over-exit rejected; CLOSED after full exit; realized P&L with fees; short-entry intent rejected; quantity/notional exclusivity; filled_quantity bound; UNMANAGED default for external positions; min-hold exempting protective/manual/safety exits; stop never moving downward; coverage resized to remaining quantity; protection refused before a positive fill; and the overlapping-sell detection.

Decision budget: make at most four design choices not covered here, and record them in the module docstrings.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/domain/errors.py (read-only), including EntryBlockedError and UnsupportedOrderCapabilityError
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (read-only, if present)
- pyproject.toml (read-only) for pytest/mypy settings
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/domain/trading.py defines OrderSide, PositionDirection, OrderType, TimeInForce, OrderPurpose, BrokerOrderStatus, TERMINAL_ORDER_STATUSES, ManagementStatus, PositionCycleState, OrderIntent, BrokerOrder, Fill, PositionCycle, Position, BudgetPolicy, EntryEligibilityPolicy, and EntryEligibilityState
mike_trade/domain/protection.py defines ProtectionKind, ProtectionStatus, ProtectionPolicy, TrailingStopState, start_protection, and combined_sell_exposure

PositionCycle accepts multiple partial BUY fills before exit, rejects any BUY fill after begin_exit or CLOSED, rejects cumulative exit quantity above entry quantity, and transitions to CLOSED when remaining_quantity reaches zero
PositionCycle.realized_pnl equals exit proceeds minus entry cost minus all fees, computed in Decimal
OrderIntent with SELL side and ENTRY purpose raises; supplying both or neither of quantity and notional raises
BrokerOrder with filled_quantity > quantity, or filled_quantity > 0 without filled_avg_price, raises
Position without explicit management defaults to UNMANAGED, and MANAGED without cycle_id raises
EntryEligibilityState/exit_allowed lets PROTECTIVE_STOP, MANUAL_CLOSE, SAFETY_EXIT, and EOD_CLOSE exits through regardless of min hold, lockouts, or the entry kill switch
TrailingStopState.ratchet raises when the new stop price is below the current stop price, and with_covered_quantity rejects quantity above remaining
start_protection raises when the cycle has zero filled entry quantity
combined_sell_exposure returns True when protective plus pending exit quantity exceeds position quantity
All money/quantity fields reject float, NaN, Infinity, and invalid negatives; datetimes must be timezone-aware UTC
Neither module imports alpaca, mike_trade.brokers, or other wave-1 domain modules at runtime
tests/contracts/test_trading_contracts.py contains both positive and negative tests and passes with targeted pytest
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
import Alpaca SDK types or broker adapters in domain modules
permit pyramiding, averaging down, planned partial exits, or short entries
allow a long protective stop to move downward
let entry blocks restrict stops, manual closes, safety exits, or fills
use float for money or quantities
import other wave-1 domain modules at runtime
run broad test suites, backtests, or create broker orders
